main_text.p: Relativa duo item sunt. primum appellatur vulgó subjunctivus articulus, ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, qui, quæ, quod. & ita declinatur:
Componitur cum τίς, ὅστις quisquis, ὁτίνος ὁτινι, & Attice ὅπου ὅτῳ: ὅ, τι ta-

page.notes: Greek accents and breathings in the diagrammatic declension are partly worn and uncertain; the printed forms of the paradigm are reproduced as far as legible. Lower part of the page is faded. The final line is cut off at the foot of the printed text.
